releaseScope: This bundled release; not a live API status probe

capabilities.description: Mock works locally. Production sign-in requires separately approved client, exact callbacks and explicit third-party consent.
Docker and Supabase CLI run an isolated real OAuth protocol test with disposable local users and clients. Not a hosted sandbox or a production client pilot.
Redacted local setup checks and optional fixed public connectivity check. Does not grant registration or inspect private credentials.
Game/studio listings, saves, follows and moderated reviews are website features, not a general in-game community API.

Private listing, sign-in and managed-playtest requests with drafts and review status. Templates and email fallback available. No anonymous write API or MCP mutations. Approval does not itself publish, register a client or schedule testers.
